item.text: I’m checking Mistral’s current documentation for the exact `mistral-vespa` CLI syntax and deployment sequence.

Run:

```bash
uv run mistral-vespa generate-migration <name> --app-dir ./vespa_app
```

Edit the generated migration, then deploy it:

```bash
uv run mistral-vespa migrate \
  --app-dir ./vespa_app \
  --config-server http://localhost:19071 \
  --query-port 8080
```

`migrate` builds the application from the migrations, uploads it, and waits for the app to become ready. See the [CLI reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/cli) and [schema migration guide](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/vespa/migrations).
